en: 2. The Book of Pairs (Khandhayamaka) 2.3 The Section on Full Understanding (Pariññāvāra) 2.3.1 The Section on the Present (Paccuppannavāra)
He who fully understands the aggregate of form also fully understands the aggregate of feeling? Yes.
Or rather, he who fully understands the aggregate of feeling also fully understands the aggregate of form? Yes.
He who does not fully understand the aggregate of form also does not fully understand the aggregate of feeling? Yes.
Or again, does he who does not fully understand the aggregate of feeling not also not fully understand the aggregate of form? Yes.
